¿Cuál es el horario de atención general?: What are the general opening hours?
Consultas externas: lunes a viernes de 8: Outpatient clinics: Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 17:00. Emergency and urgent care: 24 hours every day.
¿Cómo solicito un turno para una especia: How do I request an appointment for a specialty?
Puede solicitar un turno por teléfono al: You can request an appointment by phone at the appointments center number, through the website form, or in person at admissions. Bring your ID and health insurance or member number.
¿Qué debo hacer en caso de emergencia?: What should I do in case of an emergency?
Si es una emergencia vital, diríjase dir: If it is a life-threatening emergency, go directly to the nearest emergency room or call the local emergency number. Patients in the emergency room are prioritized by severity.
¿Aceptan obras sociales y prepagas?: Do you accept health insurance plans?
El hospital trabaja con la mayoría de la: The hospital works with most health insurance providers and private plans. Check with admissions or your insurer about coverage for services and referrals.
¿Cómo puedo obtener resultados de estudi: How can I get my test results?
Los resultados se entregan en el área de: Results are delivered at the reports desk; some tests can be checked online if you registered in the patient system. For urgent deliveries, consult your doctor.
¿Qué documentos debo traer para internac: What documents should I bring for a scheduled hospitalization?
DNI, carnet de obra social o información: ID, health insurance card or plan information, prior tests requested by the medical team, and a list of current medications. See the information sheet provided by the service.
¿Cómo solicito traslado entre hospitales: How do I request a transfer between hospitals?
Los traslados se coordinan desde la dire: Transfers are coordinated by the medical directorate or admissions. In case of medical discharge with a scheduled transfer, the social services team handles logistics and transport.
